listing.name: Galactic Markets
listing.summary: Adds utility features to check commodity shortages, surpluses, and price extremes, with options to track this data as side intel.
listing.aiSummary: Adds utility features to check commodity shortages, surpluses, and price extremes, with options to track this data as side intel.

description:
Galactic Markets

Economy services for Starsector

Galactic Markets is a utility mod that allows to check shortages and surpluses, as well as low and high prices of any commodity. Additionally, it allows to track this information in the form of side intel.

aiDescription: Allows players to monitor market conditions by identifying shortages and surpluses for any commodity. It also displays low and high price data. This information can be tracked in the form of side intel for easier reference.
